title: Fleet as One Machine: Shared Hot Cache and Remote Execution
description: All synchronized machines share one hot build cache that holds entries for the synchronized state only, and compile jobs of a machine under CPU or memory pressure run on unsaturated workers, so that nothing is computed twice in the fleet.

interactions.author: Ueli Saluz <ueli@semio-tech.com>
interactions.prompt: Make sure that all synchronized machines share the same hot cache; when one machine is under pressure other unsaturated workers execute its compilation jobs; the fleet behaves like one machine and nothing is computed twice. Manual open: repo MCP did not connect.
